package openapigen

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"example.com/strictjsonprobe/internal/platform/httpapi/httpjson"
)

type strictFixtureServer struct {
	called               int
	optionalBodyPresent  bool
	multiJSONBodyPresent bool
	optionalNonJSONCalls int
}

func (s *strictFixtureServer) CreateStrictFixture(_ context.Context, request CreateStrictFixtureRequestObject) (CreateStrictFixtureResponseObject, error) {
	s.called++
	response := CreateStrictFixture200JSONResponse(*request.Body)
	if request.Body.Name == "oversized-response" {
		response.Name = strings.Repeat("x", int(httpjson.MaxResponseBodyBytes))
	}
	return response, nil
}

func (s *strictFixtureServer) CreateOptionalStrictFixture(_ context.Context, request CreateOptionalStrictFixtureRequestObject) (CreateOptionalStrictFixtureResponseObject, error) {
	s.called++
	s.optionalBodyPresent = request.Body != nil
	return CreateOptionalStrictFixture204Response{}, nil
}

func (s *strictFixtureServer) CreateMultiStrictFixture(_ context.Context, request CreateMultiStrictFixtureRequestObject) (CreateMultiStrictFixtureResponseObject, error) {
	s.called++
	s.multiJSONBodyPresent = request.JSONBody != nil
	return CreateMultiStrictFixture204Response{}, nil
}

func (s *strictFixtureServer) CreateOptionalNonJSONFixture(_ context.Context, _ CreateOptionalNonJSONFixtureRequestObject) (CreateOptionalNonJSONFixtureResponseObject, error) {
	s.called++
	s.optionalNonJSONCalls++
	return CreateOptionalNonJSONFixture204Response{}, nil
}

func TestStrictGeneratedJSONTransport(t *testing.T) {
	server := &strictFixtureServer{}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	handler := HandlerFromMux(NewStrictHandlerWithOptions(server, nil, StrictHTTPServerOptions{
		RequestErrorHandlerFunc: func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request, err error) {
			status := http.StatusBadRequest
			switch {
			case errors.Is(err, httpjson.ErrRequestBodyTooLarge):
				status = http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge
			case errors.Is(err, httpjson.ErrUnsupportedMediaType), errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupportedRequestContentType):
				status = http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType
			}
			http.Error(w, http.StatusText(status), status)
		},
		ResponseErrorHandlerFunc: func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request, err error) {
			if !errors.Is(err, httpjson.ErrResponseBodyTooLarge) {
				t.Errorf("response error = %v, want ErrResponseBodyTooLarge", err)
			}
			http.Error(w, "internal server error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		},
		JSONBodyDecoder:           httpjson.Decode,
		JSONResponseSizeChecker:   httpjson.CheckResponseSize,
		RequestContentTypeMatcher: httpjson.MatchesMediaType,
		RequestBodyAbsentChecker:  httpjson.IsBodyAbsent,
	}), router)

	tests := []struct {
		name        string
		body        string
		contentType string
		wantStatus  int
		wantCalled  bool
	}{
		{name: "valid", body: `{"name":"ok","nested":{"value":2}}`, contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", wantStatus: http.StatusOK, wantCalled: true},
		{name: "empty required body", wantStatus: http.StatusBadRequest},
		{name: "malformed", body: `{"name":`, contentType: "application/json", wantStatus: http.StatusBadRequest},
		{name: "trailing value", body: `{"name":"ok","nested":{"value":2}} {}`, contentType: "application/json", wantStatus: http.StatusBadRequest},
		{name: "unknown field", body: `{"name":"ok","nested":{"value":2},"extra":true}`, contentType: "application/json", wantStatus: http.StatusBadRequest},
		{name: "duplicate case variant", body: `{"name":"first","Name":"second","nested":{"value":2}}`, contentType: "application/json", wantStatus: http.StatusBadRequest},
		{name: "duplicate nested field", body: `{"name":"ok","nested":{"value":1,"Value":2}}`, contentType: "application/json", wantStatus: http.StatusBadRequest},
		{name: "wrong media type", body: `{"name":"ok","nested":{"value":2}}`, contentType: "text/json", wantStatus: http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType},
		{name: "oversized", body: `{"name":"` + strings.Repeat("x", int(httpjson.MaxRequestBodyBytes)) + `","nested":{"value":2}}`, contentType: "application/json", wantStatus: http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge},
		{name: "oversized response", body: `{"name":"oversized-response","nested":{"value":2}}`, contentType: "application/json", wantStatus: http.StatusInternalServerError, wantCalled: true},
	}

	for _, tc := range tests {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			before := server.called
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/strict", strings.NewReader(tc.body))
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", tc.contentType)
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != tc.wantStatus {
				t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d; body %q", response.Code, tc.wantStatus, response.Body.String())
			}
			if called := server.called == before+1; called != tc.wantCalled {
				t.Errorf("handler called = %t, want %t", called, tc.wantCalled)
			}
		})
	}

	t.Run("empty optional body", func(t *testing.T) {
		before := server.called
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		handler.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/optional", nil))
		if response.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d; body %q", response.Code, http.StatusNoContent, response.Body.String())
		}
		if server.called != before+1 || server.optionalBodyPresent {
			t.Fatalf("handler calls = %d, body present = %t", server.called-before, server.optionalBodyPresent)
		}
	})

	t.Run("multi-content exact media selection", func(t *testing.T) {
		before := server.called
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/multi", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"ok","nested":{"value":2}}`))
		request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "Application/JSON; charset=utf-8")
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)
		if response.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d; body %q", response.Code, http.StatusNoContent, response.Body.String())
		}
		if server.called != before+1 || !server.multiJSONBodyPresent {
			t.Fatalf("handler calls = %d, JSON body present = %t", server.called-before, server.multiJSONBodyPresent)
		}
	})

	t.Run("multi-content rejects undeclared prefix", func(t *testing.T) {
		before := server.called
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/multi", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"ok","nested":{"value":2}}`))
		request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json-patch+json")
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)
		if response.Code != http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType {
			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d; body %q", response.Code, http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType, response.Body.String())
		}
		if server.called != before {
			t.Fatalf("handler calls = %d, want 0", server.called-before)
		}
	})

	t.Run("optional non-JSON multi-content empty body remains absent", func(t *testing.T) {
		before := server.called
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		handler.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/optional-non-json", nil))
		if response.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d; body %q", response.Code, http.StatusNoContent, response.Body.String())
		}
		if server.called != before+1 || server.optionalNonJSONCalls != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("handler calls = %d, optional handler calls = %d", server.called-before, server.optionalNonJSONCalls)
		}
	})

	t.Run("optional non-JSON multi-content nonempty body needs a type", func(t *testing.T) {
		before := server.called
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		handler.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/optional-non-json", strings.NewReader("data")))
		if response.Code != http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType {
			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d; body %q", response.Code, http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType, response.Body.String())
		}
		if server.called != before {
			t.Fatalf("handler calls = %d, want 0", server.called-before)
		}
	})
}
